When it is facing the moon, we get less sunlight and it gets cold.

So, when the Earth is facing the sun, we have spring and summer. Spring is a time of growth and new life, and summer is a time of fun and adventure. We have warm and sunny days, and we can play outside with our friends.

When the Earth is facing the moon, we get less sunlight and it gets cold. This is why we have autumn (fall) and winter. Autumn is a time of fall leaves and cozy warm days, and winter is a time of snow and cold temperatures.
